summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of new 'Simpan Pelanggan Reguler' flow + Anter Jemput → Courier pipeline (orderStore localStorage). All 17 sub-tests across two playwright runs PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: POSScreen.jsx is now ~1900 lines — recommend splitting modals (RegularCustomerModal, MembershipModal, QrModal, PoDModal) into separate components for maintainability (>700-line guideline).

Regular customers state is in-memory only (lost on refresh). If persistence beyond a session is desired, mirror the orderStore pattern with localStorage. (Possibly out of scope for this MVP iteration.)
pushPendingOrder dedup is by id only; same id won't be pushed twice — fine. Consider also stripping potentially stale 'eta' once Cashier provides one in the future.
seed_data_creation: Test created localStorage entries via UI (Tony Stark anter order). Cleared localStorage between runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 covered: (1) two-button row register-member-button + register-regular-button visible side-by-side; (2) regular-customer-modal with all 3 inputs + correct title; (3) staged validation toasts (Isi nama lengkap dulu / Isi nomor WhatsApp dulu / Isi alamat dulu); (4) save success toast + modal close + customer-name-input autofill; (5) regular-customer-hint shows WA + truncated address; (6) Anter Jemput E2E: kiloan auto-bumps to 3.0kg, payment proof, save-print clicked via page.evaluate, QR modal with order id; (7) localStorage entry written under key 'laundrymax_pending_courier_orders' with full order payload; (8) /courier → tab-delivery shows ready-card with Tony Stark; (9) scan-motor-button moves card to motor-card with address 'Kosan Avengers Lt.3 Kamar 7B' and phone '0812-9999-1111' both rendered; (10) PoD flow (capture delivery + confirm) removes from motor list AND from localStorage; (11) navigation away+back keeps it gone; (12) walkin order does NOT push to courier (no localStorage entry). All passing on mobile viewport (390x844).
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. Note: page.click('[data-testid="nav-courier"]') is unreliable when sticky bottom bar overlays; use page.goto('/courier') OR force=True. POSScreen.jsx already has data-testid coverage for all required selectors.
